sentences.en: I've got a diploma from the Paris Conservatory of Music.
sentences.zh: 我从巴黎音乐学院拿到了毕业文凭。

sentences.en: Is she still able to get her diploma in time?
sentences.zh: 她还能及时拿到毕业文凭吗？

sentences.en: The principal presented each of the graduates with diploma.
sentences.zh: 校长为每位毕业生颁发了毕业证书。

senses.zh: 毕业证书，学位证书；公文，文书；奖状
